common_intent_requirements.text: 把几块骨牌排成间距较小的一排
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把几块骨牌排成间距较小的一排
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a short row of upright dominoes arranged with small gaps on a level tabletop.
A hand gently tips only the first domino, then moves clear.

common_intent_requirements.text: 让它们一块碰着下一块依次倒下
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 让它们一块碰着下一块依次倒下
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: The first piece falls against the next piece, which begins tipping after the contact, and this sequence travels down the row.

physics_checks.criterion: 骨牌倒下沿排布方向通过相邻接触传递，没有无接触的远距离提前倒下。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 能辨认至少几次相邻骨牌从接触到倒下的顺序。
fail_examples: 后排骨牌在前排仍直立且无接触时集体倒下
骨牌隔着大间隙遥控下一块
牌体穿过下一块后才触发变化
not_required: 不要求骨牌数量或倒下间隔具有精确数值
边缘骨牌偏倒方向不单独判错

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
